integrity: The executable verifier regenerates the representation, interval, orbit data and quotient chain checks using exact arithmetic; finite-field screening is followed by exact rank checks, with a proved no-false-negative property.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation and homotopy classification for the single finite real Coxeter type H4; no infinite-type generalization. Unindexed equivalent prior results cannot be ruled out. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
title: Sixteen \(2\)-spheres in the Coxeter-conjugation quotient of the type-\(H_4\) noncrossing complex
